summary: The player weaves across the lane, releasing several charged shots at small pink enemies, disarming at least two of them while taking one hit that costs a hull point.

events.evidence: Cyan projectile launched upward from the player ship with a whoosh/zap sound
Projectile hits a small enemy near the top right of the lane, flashing white
After the hit, a small piece detaches, score increases to 1,318, and the greyed hull drifts away
Player ship moves left across the lane
Bright cyan charged shot fired upward from the left side
Charged shot impacts the small enemy just ahead on the left
Enemy loses its pink glow, score jumps to 1,803, and the harmless hull drifts downward
Player collides with enemy/bullet on the left; screen flashes red, heavy impact sound plays, and HULL indicator drops from 4 to 3
Player moves from the left side across to the right side of the lane
Player fires a charged shot upward while moving left
Player shifts leftward toward the center-left of the lane
The shot travels up the center-left of the lane without hitting the enemies on the right
Player moves from the left back to the right side of the lane
Charged shot fired upward on the right side
Shot hits an enemy on the right side; score increases from 1,803 to 1,951
Dark grey disarmed hull is visible drifting down after the hit and +148 score gain

readability_issues.issue: Dark grey disarmed enemy hulls and broken parts blend into the dark lane floor and are briefly hard to distinguish from active threats right before the player takes damage.
Full-screen red damage flash and chromatic aberration momentarily obscure enemy positions and projectiles on the playfield.
